evidenceType: Official product-specific consumer recall; adjacent to therapy watch
title: Galaxie Brands Corporation recalls OVERTIME Punch Out due to labelling issue

scope.product: OVERTIME Punch Out dried cannabis flower

originalSummary: The official notice says cannabinoid values were swapped: the label's total CBD 300 mg/g and total THC 0.6 mg/g should be total CBD 0.6 mg/g and total THC 300 mg/g. It describes a risk of unintended intoxication, not observed injury in this lot; no complaints or adverse reaction reports had been received at publication.
deduplication: Not present in October 21 safety pass; first publication October 21. Product/lot-specific; not included as a new watched tic-therapy signal.
supports: Existence and specified scope of this official recall.
doesNotSupport: Tourette-treatment efficacy or a new tic-treatment trial result
